metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully added page numbers to the footer of LibreOffice_Open_Source_Word_Processing.docx via Insert > Header and Footer > Footer > Default Page Style, then Insert > Field > Page Number.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can open Insert menu, navigate Header and Footer submenu, enable footer for Default Page Style, insert Page Number field, and save with Ctrl+S.
metadata.explanation: Directly verifies the original trajectory task. The getter downloads the docx from the VM as bytes, opens it as a zip, and checks all footer XML files for the PAGE field instruction. Initial state has no footer files so the check fails; after adding page numbers via footer the PAGE field appears and the check passes. [Fixed: renamed function suffix from 'ba2bccd9' (8 chars) to '035b6f0ae922d6e2d1f24326ec60c904' (32 chars) — correct MD5 of '0e47de2a-32e0-456c-a366-8c607ef7a9d2|0']
fix_history: Fix 1: Renamed getter 'get_writer_footer_pageno__ba2bccd9' -> 'get_writer_footer_pageno__035b6f0ae922d6e2d1f24326ec60c904' (invalid 8-char suffix replaced with correct 32-char MD5 hash)
Fix 3: Updated evaluator.func and evaluator.result.type in task JSON to match new 32-char hash

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly identifies footer XML files in DOCX ZIP archive using the right pattern (word/footer\d*\.xml).
Searching for \bPAGE\b in footer XML files is semantically correct — LibreOffice/DOCX encodes page number fields as PAGE field instructions in footer XML.
Initial state (no footer files in the original DOCX) correctly fails the check, providing negative-control resistance.
In DOCX format, a single footer with a PAGE field applies to all pages using that page style, so the 'every page' requirement is implicitly verified.
Save requirement is implicitly verified because the getter reads the file directly from the VM filesystem — unsaved changes would not be reflected.
Metric logic is clean and correct: 1.0 for has_page_field=True, 0.0 otherwise.
Minor theoretical concern: \bPAGE\b could match non-field uses of the word PAGE in footer XML, but in practice DOCX footer XML does not contain other standalone occurrences of PAGE.
